UsedDiskSpace
Current amount of used disk space on the system in GB. On Windows, includes space on logical fixed drives only.
AvailableDiskSpace Amount of available disk space on the system in GB. On Windows, includes space on logical fixed drives only.
AverageUsedRam
Average used RAM in MB
MaxUsedRam
Maximum used RAM in MB
